ev.q: During October 12--November 13, CDC received 111 requests from 66 countries.
10 were confirmed inhalational anthrax, and 12 (seven confirmed and five suspected) were cutaneous anthrax.
Of the 66 countries, 15 (23%) received laboratory assistance
Of the 66 countries, 15 (23%) received laboratory assistance
Of these, 47 (42%) requests were laboratory related; 43 (39%) were general requests for bioterrorism information
Since November 7, 2001, CDC and state and local public health agencies have identified no new cases of bioterrorism-related anthrax.
